propositions: Three near-identical replacement-link walkers exist across close_precheck and close_disposition modules, differing only in liveness check and return type, creating maintenance burden and enabling inconsistent behavior like bug frolicky-dependable-peccary

The duplicates/supersedes walk logic must be consolidated into a single replacement_of function while preserving class-level filtering differences and on_subject_unreadable divergence that distinguish the three callers
_NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES and DISPOSITION_CLASSES drift apart because they are restated rather than aliased, allowing behavior inconsistency; they must be the same object
The non-bug ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES narrowing applied only by _has_live_replacement_link must be preserved to maintain fc20 ticket requirements

The three wrapper functions _has_live_replacement_link, _recorded_replacement_target, and find_replacement must retain their exact names and signatures as monkeypatch seams to avoid silently breaking existing test coverage
